beats.text: She put in two tiny copper coins — together worth less than a penny. That is the whole of what Mark records about her. She does not say a word, and nobody in that courtyard looks up.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury: for all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

beats.text: I'm telling you the truth, he said — this poor widow has put in more than every one of them. They gave out of what they had spare. She gave out of what she did not have. Everyone else gave from what they had left over. She gave from what she needed.
